recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆大型組織球，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻、偶見小核仁，細胞質豐富、淡灰藍並帶細空泡，細胞間界線不清，周圍夾雜淋巴球與漿細胞，屬反應性組織球增生；此視野未見明確吞噬血球。
features: Several large histiocytes with abundant pale grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and ill-defined borders
Low N:C ratio with round to oval, centrally or eccentrically placed nuclei
Fine, open chromatin with small nucleoli in some cells
No convincing intact phagocytosed hematopoietic cells in the histiocytes in this field
Background small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, a segmented neutrophil and red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased large histiocytes with abundant pale grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli. The histiocytes appear cytologically bland without striated, foamy lipid-laden or crumpled cytoplasm. Definite hemophagocytosis is not seen in this field. Background lymphocytes, plasma cells and granulocytes are present. Findings are consistent with reactive histiocytosis; correlate clinically for infection, inflammation or evolving hemophagocytic syndrome.

ddx.vs: HLH requires histiocytes containing engulfed red cells, platelets or nucleated cells, plus clinical criteria, which are not demonstrated in this field.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm with small eccentric nuclei, rather than finely vacuolated grey-blue cytoplasm.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia and prominent nucleoli, unlike these bland individual histiocytes.
Mast cells have dense purple metachromatic granules obscuring the nucleus, which are absent here.
